category.description: The type of test case being defined

description.description: A brief summary of what the test case verifies (e.g., clicking the button <button-name> redirects to the page <page-name>).

components.description: Names of components from the component manifest that this feature depends on. Must match names in <view>.components.json.

steps.description: Ordered list of atomic actions to perform (e.g., 'navigate to main interface', 'click the button <button-name>', 'verify the page changes to <page-name>')

status.description: The implementation status of this feature.
